name: imposition-toolkit
description: Client-side PDF imposition & pre-press toolkit — 60 print-production tools plus 6 chained workflows (booklets, n-up, cards, labels, folding, large-format, tickets, marks, dielines, CSV data-merge + QR) that run entirely in the browser via pdf-lib. Framework-agnostic engine + optional React 19 UI with a dark theme.

scripts.build: esbuild src/impose.ts --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/impose.mjs && tsc src/impose.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --skipLibCheck --moduleResolution bundler --module esnext --target es2020 --outDir dist
